mapper.select: SELECT CASE status WHEN 1 THEN '正常' WHEN 0 THEN '禁用' WHEN 2 THEN '锁定' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM user WHERE 1=1 AND status = #{status} GROUP BY status
SELECT bc.category_name AS name, COUNT(b.id) AS value FROM blog b LEFT JOIN blog_category bc ON b.category_id = bc.id WHERE 1=1 AND b.status = #{status} GROUP BY bc.category_name

SELECT CASE integral_type WHEN 1 THEN '获取' WHEN 2 THEN '消耗' END AS name, SUM(integral_num) AS value FROM integral_record WHERE 1=1 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY integral_type

SELECT CASE order_status WHEN 0 THEN '待支付' WHEN 1 THEN '待发货' WHEN 2 THEN '待收货' WHEN 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN 4 THEN '已取消' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM order_info WHERE 1=1 AND pay_status = #{payStatus} GROUP BY order_status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(last_login_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM user WHERE 1=1 AND last_login_time >= #{startTime} AND last_login_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(last_login_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY name
SELECT CASE product_type WHEN 1 THEN '普通商品' WHEN 2 THEN '虚拟商品' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM product WHERE 1=1 AND status = #{status} GROUP BY product_type

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m') AS name, IFNULL(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS value FROM order_info WHERE pay_status = 1 AND pay_time IS NOT NULL AND pay_time >= #{startTime} AND pay_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY name

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m') AS name, IFNULL(SUM(i.product_num), 0) AS value FROM order_item i INNER JOIN order_info o ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.pay_status = 1 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.pay_time >= #{startTime} AND o.pay_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY name

SELECT CASE integral_source WHEN 5 THEN '订单抵扣' ELSE CONCAT('其他(', integral_source, ')') END AS name, SUM(integral_num) AS value FROM integral_record WHERE integral_type = 2 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY integral_source ORDER BY value DESC
